paragraphs.text: Zask is a legendary insect from an unknown plane.

Zask is a towering and fearsome insect with an aura of commanding authority. His body is a monstrous amalgamation of chitinous plates and exoskeletal segments, each covered in intricate patterns that glint menacingly in the light. His segmented limbs end in razor-sharp talons, and his eyes are green-glowing orbs that glint with a cold, calculating intelligence. His presence is both intimidating and enigmatic, embodying the relentless, voracious nature of the insect hive. His control over the swarming legions allows him to manipulate the very essence of life and death, ensuring that even in their demise, his minions serve to feed his growing strength.
